scope: FITMATCH sports-science parity plus acquisition operation; parent/marketplace expansion is secondary
method: Weighted engineering estimate. Stage 0 = no applicable output; 0.25 = partial implementation; 0.5 = core local workflow integrated with automated checks; 0.75 = demonstrated on intended devices and deployed infrastructure; 1 = agreed feature coverage and supporting acceptance evidence. A local workflow can still have additional feature gaps. Stage assignments are engineering judgments, not measured probabilities or accuracy scores.

categories.name: Guided four-view capture
categories.evidence: Live preview/static guide, shutter/fallback, lifecycle cleanup, provisional photo checks, consent refresh, distinct-file enforcement and processing-time provenance tested locally. Synthetic browser capture/reuse rejection verified; physical-device performance and thresholds unvalidated.

categories.name: Personalized 3D body
categories.evidence: SDK 0.13.0 generated an accepted, temporary rotatable surface from one authorized real adult four-photo set after an explicitly selected bounded cleanup removed 14 detached lower-region voxels (0.29%). The adjustment is constrained, recorded and never fills or joins geometry. Main app/SDK integration and automated topology checks pass. Anatomical accuracy, repeatability, intended-device and population validation remain unproven, so this is partial implementation only.

categories.name: 25+ anthropometrics
categories.evidence: A versioned local workflow now returns up to 25 defined length and landmark-distance estimates, including 18 bilateral proxies. One real adult four-photo set returned all 25. Metric equivalence, physical accuracy, repeatability and population validation remain unproven.

categories.name: Circumferences
categories.evidence: SDK 0.13.0 derives shoulder-midpoint, torso-midpoint and hip-midpoint plane heights from four pose views and records view-to-view spread without exposing landmarks. On the authorized adult surface, all three clothed-surface perimeters computed with exact plane, geometry and contour-selection provenance. The hip plane had three contours; exactly one contained the hip-centered reconstruction axis, so the other two were excluded without summing or choosing by size. A scalar-only three-plane repeat comparison is implemented and tested, but has no second real capture. These are experimental surface sections, not FITMATCH-equivalent anatomical circumferences. Tape accuracy, repeatability, intended-device and population validation remain untested.

categories.name: Body composition
categories.evidence: A deployed provider integration gate now validates deployment rights, DEXA training provenance, independent DEXA validation metadata, exact provider/model binding, five supported scalar outputs, uncertainty disclosure and coded DEXA comparison rows. It returns participant-aware descriptive bias, MAE, RMSE and maximum error and excludes row identifiers from aggregate export. No licensed model, real composition output or validation dataset is configured, so FM05 remains at stage 0.

categories.name: PHV and maturity offset
categories.evidence: A versioned local Mirwald 2002 combined-sample workflow computes maturity offset and estimated age at PHV from one coherent manual standing-height, sitting-height and body-mass session for ages 8–16. Parent Growth/Body Insights and authorized individual organization views are integrated; roster export and ranking are excluded. A minimum ±1-year uncertainty and individual/population limits are displayed. Intended-device, independent-reference and buyer acceptance remain unverified.

categories.name: Predicted adult height
categories.evidence: Integrated mid-parental range and growth context. Competitor equivalence unproven.

categories.name: Static asymmetry
categories.evidence: Four provisional left/right segment pairs integrated into capture, records, dashboard and reports with tests. Same-assessment comparisons only. Anatomical accuracy, side orientation and repeatability unvalidated; no injury prediction.

categories.name: History and reference comparisons
categories.evidence: Integrated parent history and stature references plus a company repeat-assessment utility. The company comparator reauthorizes two records, requires the same organization, adult reference, SDK, engine, model and unit, and reports signed descriptive changes only for shared scalar outputs. It is deployed in the signed-in portal and correctly remains inactive with the current single real record. A second independent real capture, whole-body reference cohorts and device validation remain.

categories.name: Body-insights portal
categories.evidence: Parent and read-only organization body dashboards, assessment detail and filtered exports are deployed. Organization membership policy is applied to the live ParentPlaybook Supabase project. In the user's signed-in Windows Chrome session, Bergenfield Bears loaded its one-athlete roster plus the separate organization-owned adult history; the stored real adult reference opened all 25 scalar outputs through fresh tenant checks and completed an authorized JSON export with zero browser warnings or errors. FM10 has deployed intended-desktop evidence. A generated avatar, intended-phone portal check and broader buyer acceptance remain.

categories.name: Integration and portable results
categories.evidence: Versioned measurements/exports, same-origin browser SDK and experimental OBJ/method portability are implemented. The production company SDK demo processed the authorized 74-inch adult four-photo set in the user's Windows Chrome twice: all four capture checks passed, all 25 outputs returned, and the in-memory company host contract saved the scalar assessment. The latest scan completed in 14.4 seconds, freshly reauthorized export, and created a 25-output company JSON file whose parsed payload had zero forbidden photo/landmark/geometry keys. A separate organization-scoped adult-reference adapter, strict importer and no-athlete-FK migration are deployed. The authorized adult record is stored in live Supabase under Bergenfield Bears and can reopen/export through fresh tenant checks. On pp-v83, the main signed-in organization dashboard listed this record in an adult history separate from its one child roster entry, opened all 25 scalar outputs and completed authorized JSON export with zero browser warnings or errors. Production deletion, buyer-host deployment, intended-phone and restore acceptance remain. The portable handoff now includes the same fail-closed repeat-assessment and CSV utility.

categories.name: Data protection and operation
categories.evidence: Consent and retention flows, payload allowlisting, tenant RLS, mutation audit triggers and scheduled deletion jobs are deployed in the live ParentPlaybook Supabase project. The separate adult-reference table is also deployed with organization-admin RLS, strict scalar-only validation, null athlete audit linkage and its own retention sweep. A rollback-only authenticated-role transaction verified roster-linked save/read/delete, cross-account denial and audit events with zero retained fixtures. One authorized adult reference is now persisted under Bergenfield Bears with retention through October 10, 2026; fresh-session reopen and export passed. Backup deletion, restore, buyer handover and operating evidence remain.

A dedicated buyer Demo Room is deployed at /friday-demo with direct links to the production SDK, signed-in adult persistence, composition validation gate, parent Body Insights, movement video and organization tools, plus an eight-minute run of show and visible claim boundary.
